statement: Break-glass applies only to CoSec's own token, decided by provenance, never by a name: only a principal whose token CoSec's own verifier (`JwtTokenVerifier`) verified gets it. Never an API key, capped or not, a token another TokenVerifier accepted, nor a principal another authenticator accepted, whatever its credential is called; the method `jwt` is reserved for CoSec's token (RC1-26), and only a person's (IDN-44): a CoSec token declared a workload's has no break-glass, behind a gateway as in front of it. A principal without break-glass matches no break-glass binding.
guards: engine:EngineTest#a subject without break-glass matches no break-glass binding
spi:AuthenticatedPrincipalTest#the public constructors refuse the method jwt, whatever the kind - BRK-8
